+package kgateway

+// ConsistentHash configures the hash policies used to compute the request hash for
+// consistent hashing load balancers. Hash policies are evaluated in the following order:
+// headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp.
+// If no hash policy is specified, the downstream source IP is used.
+//
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="no other fields may be set when disable is true"
+type ConsistentHash struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing on the targeted resource, including any
+	// hash policies inherited from policies applied at a higher level in the config hierarchy.
+	// When true, no other fields may be set.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers configures hashing on request header values.
+	// +optional
+	// +listType=atomic
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Headers []ConsistentHashHeader `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies configures hashing on request cookie values.
+	// If the cookie is not present and a TTL is set, Envoy generates the cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +listType=atomic
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Cookies []ConsistentHashCookie `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters configures hashing on request query parameter values.
+	// +optional
+	// +listType=atomic
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	QueryParameters []ConsistentHashQueryParameter `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState configures hashing on filter state objects.
+	// +optional
+	// +listType=atomic
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	FilterState []ConsistentHashFilterState `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIP configures hashing on the downstream source IP address.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIP *ConsistentHashSourceIP `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashHeader hashes on the value of a request header.
+type ConsistentHashHeader struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header to hash on.
+	// Header names are matched case-insensitively.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite rewrites the header value using a regular expression before hashing.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *ConsistentHashRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and this hash policy produces a hash, causes the remaining
+	// hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashRegexRewrite rewrites a value using a regular expression.
+type ConsistentHashRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the regex pattern used to match the value.
+	// The pattern must be a valid RE2 regular expression.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for the matched pattern.
+	// It can include backreferences to captured groups from the pattern (e.g., \1, \2).
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie hashes on the value of a request cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie to hash on.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL is the lifetime of the cookie generated by Envoy when the cookie is not present
+	// in the request. Accepts a duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of
+	// seconds (e.g. "3600"). If unset, Envoy does not generate the cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=64
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="self.matches('^[0-9]+$') || duration(self) >= duration('0s')",message="ttl must be a non-negative duration (e.g. 1h30m) or an integer number of seconds"
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path is the path of the cookie generated by Envoy.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes are additional attributes of the cookie generated by Envoy,
+	// e.g. SameSite, Secure, HttpOnly.
+	// +optional
+	// +listType=atomic
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Attributes []ConsistentHashCookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and this hash policy produces a hash, causes the remaining
+	// hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookieAttribute is an attribute of a generated cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie attribute, e.g. SameSite.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the value of the cookie attribute, e.g. Strict.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter hashes on the value of a request query parameter.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name is the name of the query parameter to hash on.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and this hash policy produces a hash, causes the remaining
+	// hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState hashes on the value of a filter state object.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the name of the filter state object to hash on.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and this hash policy produces a hash, causes the remaining
+	// hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIP hashes on the downstream source IP address.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIP struct {
+	// Terminal, if true and this hash policy produces a hash, causes the remaining
+	// hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}

+	sourceIP        *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherConsistentHash, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherConsistentHash.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	eq := func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool { return proto.Equal(a, b) }
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.headers, otherConsistentHash.headers, eq) &&
+		slices.EqualFunc(c.cookies, otherConsistentHash.cookies, eq) &&
+		slices.EqualFunc(c.queryParameters, otherConsistentHash.queryParameters, eq) &&
+		slices.EqualFunc(c.filterState, otherConsistentHash.filterState, eq) &&
+		proto.Equal(c.sourceIP, otherConsistentHash.sourceIP)
+}
+
+// Validate performs validation on the consistent hash component.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies() {
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if rewrite := hp.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite(); rewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(rewrite.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash header regexRewrite pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// hashPolicies returns the hash policies in canonical type order.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) hashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := slices.Concat(c.headers, c.cookies, c.queryParameters, c.filterState)
+	if c.sourceIP != nil {
+		out = append(out, c.sourceIP)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	in := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	if ptr.Deref(in.Disable, false) {
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+
+	for _, h := range in.Headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.GetHeader().RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		ir.headers = append(ir.headers, hp)
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range in.Cookies {
+		cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: ptr.Deref(c.Path, ""),
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash cookie %q ttl: %w", c.Name, err)
+			}
+			cookie.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+		}
+		for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+			cookie.Attributes = append(cookie.Attributes, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: attr.Value,
+			})
+		}
+		ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookie,
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, q := range in.QueryParameters {
+		ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, f := range in.FilterState {
+		ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	if in.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = newSourceIPHashPolicy(ptr.Deref(in.SourceIP.Terminal, false))
+	}
+
+	ir.headers = dedupHashPolicies(ir.headers)
+	ir.cookies = dedupHashPolicies(ir.cookies)
+	ir.queryParameters = dedupHashPolicies(ir.queryParameters)
+	ir.filterState = dedupHashPolicies(ir.filterState)
+
+	// Default to hashing on the source IP when no hash policy is specified
+	if len(ir.hashPolicies()) == 0 {
+		ir.sourceIP = newSourceIPHashPolicy(false)
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+func newSourceIPHashPolicy(terminal bool) *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		Terminal: terminal,
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+// parseCookieTTL parses a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+// hashPolicyKey returns the identifying key of a hash policy used for deduplication.
+// Header names are case-insensitive, so they are lowercased.
+func hashPolicyKey(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+	switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		return strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return spec.Cookie.GetName()
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+	default:
+		return ""
+	}
+}
+
+// dedupHashPolicies returns the hash policies with duplicate keys removed, keeping the
+// first occurrence of each key. The input slice is never modified.
+func dedupHashPolicies(in ...[]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	var out []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
+	for _, list := range in {
+		for _, hp := range list {
+			key := hashPolicyKey(hp)
+			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[key] = struct{}{}
+			out = append(out, hp)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+// mergeConsistentHashIR merges two consistent hash IRs, giving priority to hi.
+// Array fields are unioned (hi entries first) and deduplicated by key, while
+// sourceIp retains hi's value. A disabled hi suppresses lo entirely, and a
+// disabled lo does not affect hi. The inputs are never modified.
+func mergeConsistentHashIR(hi, lo *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if hi == nil {
+		return lo
+	}
+	if lo == nil || hi.disable || lo.disable {
+		return hi
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		headers:         dedupHashPolicies(hi.headers, lo.headers),
+		cookies:         dedupHashPolicies(hi.cookies, lo.cookies),
+		queryParameters: dedupHashPolicies(hi.queryParameters, lo.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     dedupHashPolicies(hi.filterState, lo.filterState),
+		sourceIP:        hi.sourceIP,
+	}
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies the consistent hash configuration to the Envoy route.
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies()
+}
